directions.isolation_logic: Supine chin tuck isolates deep flexors vs SCM
directions.retest_rule: Retest after deep flexor activation - >30% neck pain VAS decrease = positive

directions.isolation_logic: Upper cervical extension vs lower - nod vs whole ext
directions.retest_rule: PA mobilization C5-C6 + motor control, retest extension 2min

directions.isolation_logic: Flexion-rotation test isolates C1-C2
directions.retest_rule: Upper thoracic manipulation may improve cervical rotation >15deg

directions.isolation_logic: Check thoracic sidebend dependency
directions.retest_rule: Retest after first rib mobilization

directions.isolation_logic: Foam roller isolates thoracic vs lumbar; arms overhead biases upper T
directions.retest_rule: Retest cervical rotation or shoulder flexion or lumbar extension after PA T6-8 - need >20% improvement

directions.isolation_logic: Check if limited by extension driver
directions.retest_rule: After extension mobilization, flexion often improves automatically

directions.isolation_logic: Sitting rotation vs lumbar locked
directions.retest_rule: Open book test retest after thoracic PA

directions.isolation_logic: Prone knee flex 90deg reduces hamstring -> isolates glute vs erector; Single leg stance isolates glute med control; Hook lying draw in isolates multifidus
directions.retest_rule: Retest standing extension pain/ROM AND sitting flexion after multifidus facilitation + thoracic mobilization - needs >50% change to confirm primary driver
directions.irritability_note: High irrit -> test prone mid-range only, no standing overpressure

directions.isolation_logic: Long sitting flex isolates hamstring length vs lumbar; Supine knee to chest isolates lumbar vs hip
directions.retest_rule: After hamstring length or psoas release, retest lumbar flex 2min - >30% improvement = hip driver

directions.isolation_logic: Sitting rotation blocks hip, isolates lumbar
directions.retest_rule: Retest rotation after SIJ mobilization or hip rotator activation

directions.isolation_logic: Side plank isolates QL vs glute
directions.retest_rule: Check hip abductor strength effect on lumbar sidebend pain

directions.isolation_logic: Supine eliminates trunk compensation; Scapular assistance test isolates scapular driver vs GH; ER bias checks rotator cuff control
directions.retest_rule: If flexion improves >30deg with scapular assistance or thoracic PA T4-6, driver = scapular/thoracic not GH

directions.isolation_logic: Scaption 30deg forward reduces impingement; Empty can isolates supraspinatus
directions.retest_rule: GH inferior glide + serratus activation, retest painful arc

directions.isolation_logic: sidelying ER isolates cuff vs deltoid
directions.retest_rule: After thoracic extension + posterior GH mobilization, ER should improve >20%

directions.isolation_logic: Thomas test isolates rectus vs psoas; Supine with lumbar neutral isolates hip vs lumbar
directions.retest_rule: After psoas release + glute activation, retest squat depth

directions.isolation_logic: Knee flexed isolates glute vs hamstring; Prone hip ext with palpation
directions.retest_rule: If lumbar pain reduces after glute facilitation, primary = glute inhibition driver

directions.isolation_logic: Sidelying abduction with slight ER isolates glute med vs TFL; Standing checks functional control
directions.retest_rule: After glute med facilitation, retest single leg stance pelvic drop - <50% drop = positive

directions.isolation_logic: Passive vs active to separate joint vs muscle; Check hip flex influence
directions.retest_rule: After patellar mobilization + quad activation, retest flexion pain

directions.isolation_logic: Terminal knee ext isolates VMO
directions.retest_rule: Immediate improvement after patella medial glide = PF driver

directions.isolation_logic: Knee flexed isolates soleus vs gastrocnemius; Lunge test functional
directions.retest_rule: After calf length + talocrural AP mobilization, retest lunge knee-to-wall >2cm improvement = positive
